title: VESPER Capability Registration
description: REM-003 §4.2. The registration record for a capability (a tool, an actuator, a write path). Its whole purpose is `declared_level_rules`: COC Part VII classifies ACTIONS but supplies no evaluator, so `shell.run("ls")` and `shell.run("rm -rf ~")` are the same tool. Argument sensitivity is mandatory and is the point. Authority: SR-021, SR-022; COC Part VII; INV-AUTH-5; CI-011.

argument_schema.description: JSON Schema for this capability's arguments. `declared_level_rules` is a TOTAL function over it: every argument shape must match at least one rule, which is why the catch-all rule is mandatory below.

declared_level_rules.description: INV-AUTH-5. At least two entries, so a constant level is UNEXPRESSIBLE. This is the structural form of 'a tool that returns a constant regardless of arguments is rejected at registration' -- CI-011 checks the shape, and the schema makes the violating shape invalid before CI ever runs.

predicate.description: A total, side-effect-free expression over the declared arguments. Example for fs.write: `path in GOVERNED_PATHS`. Evaluated with no model access.

required_level_rules.description: `authorized  <=>  effective_level >= required_level(args)`. Separate from declared_level because the level an action REACHES and the level it DEMANDS are different questions; collapsing them is how an under-privileged call silently becomes a privileged one.

reversibility.description: REM-012 §4. `irreversible` capabilities are the class where a duplicate is unrecoverable, so INV-EXT-1's outbox and INV-EXT-2's reconciliation probe are mandatory for them.

actuation_scope.description: REM-005. A capability with AUTONOMOUS_ACTUATION requires a fresh enable token per invocation when driven autonomously (INV-STOP-1). ALARM_ACTUATION survives STOP_AUTONOMY so that stopping autonomy does not silently defeat SR-043's alarms.

external_effect.description: True if invoking this capability can be observed outside VESPER. Requires an outbox record before the effect (INV-EXT-1) and a reconciliation probe before any retry (INV-EXT-2).

requires_owner_confirmation.description: L4 semantics: binds to exactly one command instance. See grant.schema.json `issued_for_command_id`.

owner_administrative.description: INV-ADMIN-1: per-instance owner confirmation, never delegable, never invocable during FREE_TIME. RB-013's narrowing is recorded as an owner-approved deviation (SR-039).

model_access.description: Whether invoking this capability may reach a model. MUST be false for anything reachable from the trigger evaluator sandbox: INV-TRIG-2 requires model-denial in the decision path to be observable, and CI-023 scans for it.

allOf.description: TOTALITY: exactly one catch-all rule is required. Without it, an argument shape matching no rule has an undefined level, and an undefined level becomes a permissive one at the first call site that needs it to work.

$comment: EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: a scalar `level` field. Its absence is what makes argument-insensitive authorization unexpressible rather than merely discouraged. An implementation cannot register `shell.run` at a single level, because there is no field to put it in.
